setting_dblclickShowSubDoc_desp: If you do not use the double-click feature, disabling it can reduce single-click latency (equivalent to setting the double-click detection window to 0). However, regardless of whether this is enabled, the plugin will take over left-click events on document items in the document tree. Please note that this may be incompatible with other plugins or code snippets.
setting_prefetchSubDocsForDoubleClick_na: 🧪 Pre-fetch Sub-documents to Speed Up Double-click Expansion
setting_prefetchSubDocsForDoubleClick_de: This feature attempts to reduce the latency of expanding the document tree via double-click. When enabled, the first click fetches and constructs the list of sub-documents to be expanded, and the second click (double-click) directly inserts the pre-constructed list into the document tree. Disabling this option retains the method of simulating clicks on the expand button.
setting_dblclickDelay_name: 🔄️ Single-click Delay & Mobile Double-click Detection Interval
setting_dblclickDelay_desp:
Unit: milliseconds. The single-click action (opening a document or expanding/collapsing) is executed only if no second click occurs within this delay period.
Recommended value: 200–400. If you find the single-click response too slow, you may decrease this value slightly, but it is not recommended to set it below 200 ms.
setting_revertBehavior_desp: When disabled: single-click opens the document, double-click expands sub-documents. When enabled: single-click expands sub-documents, double-click opens the document. If there are no sub-documents, clicking will prioritize opening the document.
setting_disableChangeIcon_desp: When enabled, clicking the icon will be treated as clicking the document title, subject to the plugin's single/double-click management.
setting_extendClickArea_desp: When enabled, clicking `>` will be treated as clicking the document title, subject to the plugin's single/double-click management, rather than necessarily expanding sub-documents.
setting_shiftMultiSelect_desp: When enabled, Shift+Click in the document tree (and dialog document selection when enabled) selects all documents between the last clicked item and the current one; previously selected items outside this range will be deselected. Only affects the document tree and dialog document selection; the outline and tag panels are unaffected. Desktop only.
setting_unfoldSubDocsWhileOpenParent_nam: Expand/Collapse Child Nodes When Opening Parent Document
setting_unfoldSubDocsWhileOpenParent_des: (For outlines, the corresponding node will be expanded/collapsed after navigation.) Note that in the current implementation, nodes are expanded first and then the document is opened, but there may still be issues with focus not being placed on the document. If both "Treat Documents as Folders" and "Swap Logic" are enabled, this option will be forcibly disabled.
setting_sameToOutline_desp: When enabled, the settings in "Click Behavior" will also apply to the outline panel. For dynamically loaded documents, enabling this may cause lag during outline navigation and scrolling after navigation.
setting_applyToDialog_name: Take Over Document Selection in Dialogs
setting_applyToDialog_desp: When enabled, the settings in "Click Behavior" will also apply to dialogs such as move target selection and flashcard scope selection.
setting_enableMobile_desp: When enabled, single/double-click behavior in the document tree on Android devices will also be managed by this plugin.
setting_openToTop_name: ❌ Do Not Scroll to Last Position When Opening Document
setting_openToTop_desp: When enabled, opening a document will no longer scroll to the last edited position.
setting_sameToTag_desp: When enabled, the behaviors configured in "Click Behavior" will also apply to the tag panel.
setting_lastModifyBlockHint_desp: Displays a hint showing the last recorded clicked block position when opening a document. This feature is only meaningful when "Do Not Scroll to Last Position When Opening Document" is enabled.
setting_ignoreModifyHintIds_name: ❌ Ignore Last Edit Position Hint for Specific Document IDs
setting_ignoreModifyHintIds_desp: Enter document IDs separated by commas. These documents will not display the last edit position hint. To exclude sub-documents, append / after the parent document ID.
setting_treatAsFolder_desp: (Requires "Swap Logic" to be enabled simultaneously.) Documents will be prioritized as folders, and single-clicks will immediately trigger expansion without delay.
setting_debugMode_desp: When enabled, more logs will be output to the console. If you encounter issues, please enable this and provide the logs to the developer. If no issues are encountered, it is recommended to keep this disabled for better performance.
